text:
```yaml
name: Windows Installer

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup MSYS2
        uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        with:
          msystem: MINGW64
          path-type: inherit
          install: >-
            base-devel
            mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python
            mingw-w64-x86_64-pip
            mingw-w64-x86_64-cmake
            mingw-w64-x86_64-ninja

      - name: Provision MSYS2 packages
        run: |
          ./provision-msys2.sh

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Build C++ runtime
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. -G Ninja
          ninja

      - name: Prepare installer files
        run: |
          # Copy built runtime to the folder expected by Inno Setup
          mkdir -p installer_files
          cp -r build/* installer_files/
          # Ensure the launcher and README are included
          cp StartOpenPLC.bat installer_files/
          cp windows/README.md installer_files/

      - name: Install Inno Setup
        uses: r0adkll/inno-setup-action@v1
        with:
          path: setup.iss
          output: installer_files/OpenPLC_Runtime_Installer.exe

      - name: Upload installer artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: OpenPLC_Runtime_Installer
          path: installer_files/OpenPLC_Runtime_Installer.exe

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          files: installer_files/OpenPLC_Runtime_Installer.exe
          generate_release_notes: true
```
